mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 55 degrees under clear skies at Verona Community Park with a moderate air quality index of 57. We are under a third quarter moon, and you can catch the International Space Station at 4:57 AM as it rises over Cross Plains and arcs toward the southeast near Oregon, reaching halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona contracts with Pellitteri Waste Systems for residential refuse and recycling collection. Residents should visit the Pellitteri website to download their app and view the 2026 collection calendars to ensure they are on schedule for pick up.

There is a yoga session at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, or Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's, followed by live music at Paddy Mac's.
On October 25, officers responded to a report of a man passed out at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, which resulted in an arrest for an O W I first offence.
The flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
